title: 结构注意力税：检索格式如何劫持上下文学习
summary: 研究发现RAG系统中知识图谱三元组的结构格式会独立于语义内容吸引2-3倍注意力，压缩演示注意力达42%。提出正式框架分解注意力为语义和结构成分，推导压缩界限，并验证源任务对齐比门控策略更重要。提出五种结构感知缓解策略。
summary_en: Identifies 'structural attention tax' where KG triples capture 2-3x more attention than equivalent text, compressing demonstration attention by 42%. Formal framework decomposes attention into semantic and structural components; source-task alignment dominates over gating strategies. Proposes five mitigation strategies.
